column1: # bootstrap/manifest.tsv - every byte setup_fast.sh may download, pinned by sha256 and size.
# The amm_sim_rs post1 wheel and harness.py are Taylor's release assets (tag sim-6b6921f8);
# Tab-separated columns: set, kind, sha256, size_bytes, filename, url.
#   kind = python | wheel | engine-src | harness | solc
# There is no macos-arm64:engine set: the engine wheel is Linux x86_64 only.
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Do not reorder columns; setup_fast.sh and the tests parse this.
